name: Starlings
line: A murmuration of light turning through the branches

name: Frost
line: Hoarfrost: leaves glinting white a few at a time, a blush of pink drifting through the outer branches

name: Sap
line: Light rising from the foot of the trunk and out along the branches, a limb at a time

name: Prism
line: A ribbon of the spectrum winding up through the tree

name: Fjord
line: Arcs of sea light rolling out through the crown like ripples

name: Glass
line: Each twig a pane of coloured glass, lit a few at a time along the branches

name: Lighthouse
line: Two beams turning round the trunk through the haze, like a beacon on the fjord

name: October
line: Embers: leaves kindling one by one as the wind crosses the crown

name: Oslo
line: The tree's own song: snakes of light running leaf by leaf along every branch
